Compare multiple Bayesian evidence synthesis models

Source: R/compare_models.R
compare_evidsynth.Rd

Fits multiple modular/joint synthesis strategies (e.g., `"joint"`, `"cut"`, `"independent"`, `"melding"`, `"elastic"`, `"tempered"`) to the same dataset and collects tidy posterior summaries and survival curves for side-by-side comparison.

Usage

compare_evidsynth(
  prevalence_data = NULL,
  progression_data,
  models = c("joint", "cut", "independent", "melding", "elastic", "tempered"),
  ...
)

Arguments

prevalence_data

Aggregate survey or plug-in prevalence data passed to [evidsynth_fit()].

progression_data

Individual-level survival (and optional linked test) data passed to [evidsynth_fit()].

models

Character vector of synthesis strategies to fit. Default is `c("joint", "cut", "independent", "melding", "elastic", "tempered")`.

...

Additional arguments passed to [evidsynth_fit()] (such as `imperfect_test`, `coupling`, `cohort_type`, `surv_dist`, `n_iter`, `n_burnin`, `chains`, `seed`).

Value

A list of class `"evidsynth_comparison"` with components:

`fits`

Named list of `"evidsynth_fit"` objects.

`summary_table`

Combined tibble of posterior summaries across all fitted models.

`draws_long`

Combined long-format tibble of key parameter posterior draws across models.
